5 seconds, no Googling. How far did Eutychus fall? Comment ✅ or ❌ 👇

Paul preached until midnight, a young man named Eutychus fell asleep in the window, and went down. Paul ran down, held him and said “his life is in him.” Then he went back up and kept teaching until daybreak. Ever nodded off in a long sermon?
